ios.desc:
Since its launch, White Cane App has helped countless blind and visually impaired people around the world, receiving widespread acclaim!

White Cane is a powerful obstacle detection application, specifically designed for the visually impaired to navigate safely. It helps avoid nearby obstacles by real-time detection of their distance, preventing injuries.

Employing the latest technology, it uses the iPhone's LIDAR scanner and TrueDepth camera for distance measuring, boasting stability and high precision. It can measure distances up to 5 meters with centimeter-level accuracy, specially designed for the blind.

Key Features:
- Provides auditory and vibrational feedback indicating the proximity of obstacles.
- Real-time announcements of the actual distance of obstacles.
- Supports customization of alert tones for different distances.
- Allows adjustment of the detection field of view, both horizontally and vertically.

Supported Devices:
All Apple devices are equipped with a LIDAR scanner or Face ID feature.
